title: Test invalid repository import responses
description: Add focused unit tests for the client-side validation of repository import responses. The repository API contract requires revision-bound data and safe repository-relative paths; invalid responses must fail with RepositoryApiError instead of reaching the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests in tests/repository-api.test.ts prove that importPublicRepository rejects an invalid commit SHA, a traversal path containing '..', and a response with more than 10,000 entries.
Each rejection is asserted to be a RepositoryApiError with the invalid-response message.
Tests stub globalThis.fetch and restore it after each case so the existing URL parser test and other test files remain isolated.
The focused tests, bun run test, bun run typecheck, and bun run build pass; no production code or dependency changes are made unless a test exposes a directly related defect.

steps.description: Inspect existing API validation and test conventions
steps.details: Read AGENTS.md, docs/AGENT-SKILLS.md, docs/04-repository-data-and-api.md section 8, src/repository-api.ts, and tests/repository-api.test.ts. Preserve the project's Node test runner and existing test style.

In tests/repository-api.test.ts, mock globalThis.fetch with otherwise valid import payloads, changing only commitSha, an entry path, or entries length for each invalid case. Assert importPublicRepository rejects with RepositoryApiError and the invalid-response message. Restore the original fetch implementation in a finally block or test cleanup even if an assertion fails.

steps.description: Run project checks and record evidence
steps.details: Run the focused repository API test, then bun run test, bun run typecheck, and bun run build from the repository root. Fix only failures caused by this task. Do not start the dev server or install dependencies for this test-only change.

technicalNotes: Response validation is implemented in src/repository-api.ts; this task is intended to add regression coverage without changing behavior.
Do not read, print, or modify .env values.
No screenshot is needed because this task has no UI changes.
